plan:
- Electrical: Arduino Mega 2560/RAMPS 1.4 board, 4x NEMA 17 stepper motors, A4988/DRV8825 drivers, hotend assembly (heater cartridge, thermistor, nozzle), 3x endstop switches, 12V/24V power supply unit.
- Mechanical: Aluminum extrusion frame (e.g., 2020 profile), linear smooth rods, LM8UU linear bearings, GT2 timing belts and pulleys, lead screw for Z-axis.
- Extrusion System: MK8 or E3D V6 type hotend, Bowden or direct drive extruder mechanism, PTFE tubing for Bowden setup.
- Build Platform: Heated print bed (aluminum plate + silicone heater or PCB heatbed) with glass or PEI sheet, bed leveling springs.
- Hardware: Various M3/M4 screws, nuts, washers, T-nuts for extrusions, couplings for Z-axis, wiring harnesses, fans for hotend/part cooling.

subSteps.title: 3D print all PLA mechanical mounts and components
3D print all PETG electrical component mounts
Deburr and clean all 3D printed parts, ensure proper fit for bearings and fasteners
Install stepper drivers onto RAMPS 1.4 shield and attach RAMPS shield to Main Controller MCU
Wire Main Power Supply Unit to RAMPS shield 12V input
Connect Stepper Motors to their respective drivers on the RAMPS shield
Connect Hotend Heater Cartridge, Hotend Thermistor, Heated Bed, and Heated Bed Thermistor to RAMPS shield
Connect X, Y, and Z-Axis Min Endstop Switches to RAMPS shield
Route and organize all electrical wiring, ensure strain relief
Flash 3D printer firmware (e.g., Marlin) to the Main Controller MCU
Configure firmware settings for stepper drivers, endstops, thermistors, and heaters
Verify power supply output voltage with multimeter
Test endstop functionality (M119 command) and adjust if necessary
Test thermistor readings for hotend and heated bed (M105 command)
Perform initial motor movement tests for X, Y, Z axes and Extruder (G1 commands)
Assemble the main frame structure using extrusions and M5 T-nuts/screws
Install Y-axis smooth rods and assemble Y-bed frame with LM8UU bearings
Mount the heated print bed, print bed aluminum plate, glass build surface, and bed leveling springs to the Y-axis bed frame
Assemble X-axis carriage with hotend, fans, and LM8UU bearings; install X-axis smooth rods
Install Z-axis lead screw, Z-axis coupler, Z-axis leadscrew nut mount, and Z-axis stepper motor
Install GT2 timing belts, pulleys, and idlers for X and Y axes; mount X and Y stepper motors
Mount Main Controller MCU, RAMPS shield, Power Supply, and Bowden Extruder with PTFE tubing
Perform final cable management, zip-tying, and ensure smooth mechanical movement of all axes

tools: Soldering iron (for general electrical work, if needed)
assumptions: Familiarity with 3D printer firmware configuration (e.g., Marlin)
Access to a computer with Arduino IDE or similar for firmware flashing
Basic electrical wiring knowledge and safety practices
